RSS distances from ideologue's call to shoot protesters, FIR filed

The Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) has distanced itself from comments made by TG Mohandas, a Hindutva ideologue, who stated he would have shot protesters. The RSS clarified that Mohandas is not an official of the organization. In Kerala, an FIR has been filed against Mohandas for his remarks concerning protesters, specifically those at Jantar Mantar. The ideologue's statement suggested a violent response to the demonstrations.
